title: Phytogenic rGO@ZnCo2O4 spinel nanoarchitecture for solar-induced detoxification of endocrine disruptors: interface engineering and charge carrier modulation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00830A, Paper
Bharti Agarwal, Manviri Rani, Uma Shanker
rGO@ZnCo2O4 nanocomposite synthesized via green route exhibits superior visible-light-driven photocatalytic degradation of phthalates, offering an eco-friendly solution for removal of endocrine-disrupting pollutants.
